### `entasis_shape_bounds_fn`

computes oriented bounds without translating the shape

```c
typedef entasis_status_t (ENTASIS_CALL *entasis_shape_bounds_fn)(void * user_context, const void * shape, const entasis_quaternion_t * orientation, entasis_shape_access_t access, entasis_shape_bounds_t * out_bounds);
```

| Parameter      | C type                         | Meaning                                                    |
| -------------- | ------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `user_context` | `void *`                       | caller-owned context, borrowed through world destruction   |
| `shape`        | `const void *`                 | original stored custom payload, borrowed for this callback |
| `orientation`  | `const entasis_quaternion_t *` | orientation to apply about the local origin                |
| `access`       | `entasis_shape_access_t`       | read-only callback-local child-access scope                |
| `out_bounds`   | `entasis_shape_bounds_t *`     | output bounds                                              |

returns the operation status. outputs are discarded on failure. foreign unwinding is forbidden

### `entasis_custom_shape_registration_t`

storage and callback description copied during custom registration

register before the first successful world step. the callback table is copied. user_context remains borrowed until world destruction. payloads keep their exact caller representation. callbacks may run on worker/query threads and must synchronize their own shared data. world mutation and ordinary world API reentry from callbacks are forbidden. registering a type alone does not install collision or sweep pair routes

| `batch_type`       | `entasis_shape_batch_type_t` | shape storage classification                                   |
| `size`             | `uint64_t`                   | exact payload size, greater than zero                          |

| `minimum_progression`     | `float`                   | minimum advancement used by the native solver                 |
| `convergence_threshold`   | `float`                   | native convergence threshold                                  |
| `maximum_iteration_count` | `int32_t`                 | maximum solver iterations                                     |

### `entasis_sweep_task_result_t`

custom sweep interval and hit geometry

initialized to a miss at maximum_t with child indices -1. a hit requires finite geometry and 0 <= t0 <= maximum_t and t0 <= t1. t1 may exceed maximum_t as in the native conservative interval. the engine flips normals and child indices for reversed routes. outputs are discarded on error

Size `44`, alignment `4`

| Field      | C type              | Meaning                                          |
| ---------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `t0`       | `float`             | lower time bound                                 |
| `t1`       | `float`             | upper time bound                                 |
| `location` | `entasis_vector3_t` | world hit location                               |
| `normal`   | `entasis_vector3_t` | world normal from B toward A                     |
| `child_a`  | `int32_t`           | child index A, or -1                             |
| `child_b`  | `int32_t`           | child index B, or -1                             |
| `hit`      | `entasis_bool_t`    | ENTASIS_TRUE for a hit, ENTASIS_FALSE for a miss |

### `entasis_collision_task_registration_t`

copied scalar and wide convex collision route

register before stepping. descriptors are snapshotted before output writes and allocator callbacks. user_context remains caller-owned through world destruction. registration does not replace an existing route or consume an ID on failure. both callbacks are required. clear/reuse preserves bindings. callbacks may run concurrently and must synchronize shared application data. no global/TLS routing, payload header or per-pair allocation is used

Size `48`, alignment `8`

| Field            | C type                           | Meaning                                                                           |
| ---------------- | -------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `struct_size`    | `uint32_t`                       | initialize to sizeof this structure                                               |
| `struct_version` | `uint32_t`                       | initialize to 1                                                                   |
| `shape_type_a`   | `entasis_shape_type_id_t`        | registered type A                                                                 |
| `shape_type_b`   | `entasis_shape_type_id_t`        | registered type B                                                                 |
| `batch_size`     | `uint32_t`                       | batch capacity from 1 through 32                                                  |
| `pair_type`      | `entasis_collision_pair_type_t`  | native pair-storage classification                                                |
| `user_context`   | `void *`                         | caller-owned registration context, distinct from the current query filter context |
| `test`           | `entasis_collision_task_fn`      | required scalar callback                                                          |
| `wide_test`      | `entasis_collision_task_wide_fn` | required eight-lane callback                                                      |

### `entasis_sweep_task_registration_t`

copied top-level and child sweep route

register before stepping. descriptors are snapshotted before output writes and allocator callbacks. user_context remains caller-owned through world destruction. registration does not replace an existing route or consume an ID on failure. both callbacks are required. clear/reuse preserves bindings. callbacks may run concurrently and must synchronize shared application data. no global/TLS routing, payload header or per-pair allocation is used

Size `40`, alignment `8`

| Field            | C type                    | Meaning                                                                           |
| ---------------- | ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `struct_size`    | `uint32_t`                | initialize to sizeof this structure                                               |
| `struct_version` | `uint32_t`                | initialize to 1                                                                   |
| `shape_type_a`   | `entasis_shape_type_id_t` | registered type A                                                                 |
| `shape_type_b`   | `entasis_shape_type_id_t` | registered type B                                                                 |
| `user_context`   | `void *`                  | caller-owned registration context, distinct from the current query filter context |
| `test`           | `entasis_sweep_task_fn`   | required top-level callback                                                       |
| `child_test`     | `entasis_sweep_task_fn`   | required callback preserving parent and local child poses                         |

### `entasis_compound_task_registration_t`

callback-free native compound collision route

register before stepping. the descriptor is copied before writing out_task_id, which may alias one descriptor field. uses the existing Bounds_Tested native compound traversal without allocating a callback binding or adding per-body/per-query storage. shape B must be an engine-owned Compound, Big_Compound or Mesh. Convex_Compound requires registered convex A. Compound_Pair requires engine-owned compound types on both sides. those built-in routes already exist and cannot be replaced. a custom shape tagged Compound is not native compound storage. child collision tasks must be registered separately. no missing child route is synthesized. Subtask_Generator is required. only Child_Order and Mesh_Reduction may additionally be set. these are task metadata, not switches that disable native filtering or reduction. failure does not consume a task ID. clear/reuse retains routes. mutation, read-phase and callback-reentry restrictions are unchanged

Size `28`, alignment `4`

| Field            | C type                                  | Meaning                                                                                      |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `struct_size`    | `uint32_t`                              | initialize to sizeof this structure                                                          |
| `struct_version` | `uint32_t`                              | initialize to 1                                                                              |
| `shape_type_a`   | `entasis_shape_type_id_t`               | registered convex type for Convex_Compound. engine-owned compound type for Compound_Pair     |
| `shape_type_b`   | `entasis_shape_type_id_t`               | engine-owned Compound, Big_Compound or Mesh type, never a custom payload                     |
| `batch_size`     | `uint32_t`                              | batch capacity from 1 through 32                                                             |
| `kind`           | `entasis_collision_task_kind_t`         | Convex_Compound or Compound_Pair                                                             |
| `capabilities`   | `entasis_collision_task_capabilities_t` | Subtask_Generator required. Child_Order and Mesh_Reduction are optional native metadata bits |

returns the continuous detection

| `out_task_id`  | `int32_t *`                                     | required registered task ID. -1 on failure |
| `diagnostic`   | `entasis_diagnostic_t *`                        | optional diagnostic output                 |

returns the operation status

### `entasis_collision_task_compound_register`

registers callback-free native compound traversal for a new pair route

register before stepping. the descriptor is copied before writing out_task_id, which may alias one descriptor field. uses the existing Bounds_Tested native compound traversal without allocating a callback binding or adding per-body/per-query storage. shape B must be an engine-owned Compound, Big_Compound or Mesh. Convex_Compound requires registered convex A. Compound_Pair requires engine-owned compound types on both sides. those built-in routes already exist and cannot be replaced. a custom shape tagged Compound is not native compound storage. child collision tasks must be registered separately. no missing child route is synthesized. Subtask_Generator is required. only Child_Order and Mesh_Reduction may additionally be set. these are task metadata, not switches that disable native filtering or reduction. failure does not consume a task ID. clear/reuse retains routes. mutation, read-phase and callback-reentry restrictions are unchanged

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_status_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_collision_task_compound_register(entasis_world_t * world, const entasis_compound_task_registration_t * registration, int32_t * out_task_id, entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

| Parameter      | C type                                         | Meaning                                    |
| -------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `world`        | `entasis_world_t *`                            | world while idle                           |
| `registration` | `const entasis_compound_task_registration_t *` | description copied during registration     |
| `out_task_id`  | `int32_t *`                                    | required registered task ID. -1 on failure |
| `diagnostic`   | `entasis_diagnostic_t *`                       | optional diagnostic output                 |

returns the operation status
